CITY OF ALHAMBRA HISTORIC PRESERVATION COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  January 22, 2025

The audio recording of the meeting is available here: HPC Meeting – January 22, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  6:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Chen, Littlefield, Ng, Michelson, Amaro

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director of Community Development; Maia
  McCurley, Principal Planner; Karabeth Garcia, Executive Assistant; Greg
  Murphy, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Amaro

D.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS FOR 2024-2025: Nomination and election of Secretary of the
  Historic Preservation Commission for 2024-2025 (6:00 P.M.).

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Andrew Ho, Director of Community
  Development, as Secretary of the Historic Preservation
  Commission for 2024-2025.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Chen, Seconded by Commissioner
  Littlefield.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-1-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Littlefield, Ng, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Michelson
  Absent:  None

E.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – DECEMBER 4, 2024 (6:02 P.M.)
  •  Request: This is a request for the Historic Preservation
  Commission to approve the Minutes of the December 4, 2024,
  Regular Meeting of the Alhambra Historic Preservation
  Committee.
  •  Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the December 4, 2024, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Historic Preservation Commission.
  MOTION:

  1
  1/22/2025
   •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Littlefield, Seconded by Commissioner
  Chen.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Littlefield, Ng, Michelson, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

F.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DRAFT HISTORIC PRESERVATION ORDINANCE (6:04 P.M.)
  •  This is a continuation of the discussion on the options for how to
  proceed with the Draft Historic Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Recommended Action: It is recommended that the Historic
  Preservation Commission consider, discuss, deliberate, and
  arrive at consensus on the 13 provision alternatives for the Draft
  Historic Preservation Ordinance, as well as any additional
  substantive revisions to the Draft Historic Preservation Ordinance.
  •  The City’s consultant, Historic Resources Group (HRG), and
  sub-consultant, Architectural Resources Group (ARG),
  provided the presentation.
  •  The public comment portion of the Discussion Item was
  opened and closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Jason Carrol
  2.) Jennifer Ng
  3.) Brett Meredith
  4.) Chris Fosselman
  5.) Terry Harding

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to proceed with Option B (Revised Draft Historic
  Preservation Ordinance Provision #1).
  •  Moved by Commissioner Chen, Seconded by Commissioner
  Littlefield.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-1-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Littlefield, Ng, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Michelson
  Absent:  None

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to proceed with Option A/B (Revised Draft Historic
  Preservation Ordinance Provision #2).
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ng, Seconded by Vice President
  Michelson.

  •  Recess at 7:57 P.M.
  •  Reconvene at 8:03 P.M.

MOTION:

  (Revised Draft Historic Preservation Ordinance Provision #7).

G.  PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Lewis McCammon commented on the placement of Public Comment on the
  Agenda, suggesting to move it to the beginning of the meeting with a maximum
  5
  1/22/2025
   time limit. Mr. McCammon appreciated having more information on the Agenda,
  and suggested streaming the meetings online or having a Zoom option. (10:04
  P.M.)

  •  Jennifer Ng suggested to post the Power Point Presentation with the audio
  recording online. Ms. Ng suggested meeting twice a month, and thanked the
  Commission and staff for the work that they are doing. (10:10 P.M.)

H.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned in memory of the
  victims of the Eaton and Palisades fires, and the lost historic resources at 10:20
  P.M. to Wednesday, February 26, 2025, at 6:00 P.M.
